title: The seawall, Wednesday
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wednesday, seven. The same view. Rain. The town through rain is a different town: the sign lit in daytime, which it never is. Wood draws the lit sign at seven AM. Someone left it on. The strip records it and won't say who.

panels.composition: The town from the seawall, Wednesday, rain: the Lanes' sign lit in daylight across the road, every letter, the neon pale in the gray. WOOD under the pad. BARNABY under Wood.

panels.composition: The pad, spotted with rain: the sign, lit, at seven AM. Wednesday.

panels.composition: The town in rain. The sign lit. Wood on the wall. The strip records the sign lit at seven and never says who left it. (Nobody did.)
